sermon.title: Four Necessary but Risky Present Day Truths, Part 2
sermon.series: Four Necessary but Risky Present Day Truths
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: In this message Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that God raised up adversaries and raiding bands to correct His people, and that citizens who keep silent about corrupt government share the price. From Isaiah, John 12, Psalm 73 and Daniel 12 he warns of a day of reckoning for unjust judges and laws, and says the wise understand the times, endure calmly, keep preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and turn away from those who do not preach Bible morality.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added by hand, and obvious caption errors were corrected; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor note: his account and dates of terrorist attacks on America beginning April 14, 1972, the figure that twenty-five percent of Americans attend church regularly, and his statements about Islam, Muslims, homosexuality, the president, a television news report and mega churches are his own and are not verified here. He refers to news “this week” without naming it. Several words are marked [unclear].

scriptures.text_nkjv: But know this, that in the last days perilous times will come: For men will be lovers of themselves, lovers of money, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy, unloving, unforgiving, slanderers, without self-control, brutal, despisers of good, traitors, headstrong, haughty, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God, having a form of godliness but denying its power. chunks.section_question: Should Christians follow the multitude or churches that don’t preach Bible morality? (Matthew 15:14)
chunks.short_answer: He says from such turn away; we follow Jesus and the Bible, and “the Bible says don’t follow a multitude to do evil.” He says if mega churches were really preaching the word this would not have happened in America, and Jesus said of blind leaders of the blind, leave them alone.

faqs.question: Whom did the Lord raise up against Solomon?
faqs.answer: He names Hadad the Edomite, Rezon the king of Syria, and Jeroboam, one of his own people.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Now the LORD raised up an adversary against Solomon, Hadad the Edomite; he was a descendant of the king in Edom.

faqs.question: What does he say about God dealing with enemies while correcting His people?
faqs.answer: He says Muslims are fighting internally, so God deals with enemies while He is dealing with His people.

faqs.question: Is the conspiracy material on the internet true?
faqs.answer: He says a lot of the conspiracy material on the internet is a bunch of baloney, and most opposition to the Bible and God is flat-out lies he can answer with the truth.

faqs.question: Why do the wicked seem to prosper?
faqs.answer: He says the psalmist was jealous of the prosperity of the wicked until he went into the presence of God and understood their end.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Until I went into the sanctuary of God; Then I understood their end. Surely You set them in slippery places; You cast them down to destruction. Oh, how they are brought to desolation, as in a moment! They are utterly consumed with terrors.

faqs.question: What percentage of Americans does he say attend church regularly?
faqs.answer: He says only twenty-five percent attend church regularly in America.

faqs.question: Do Christians know the day and hour?
faqs.answer: He says we don’t know the day and hour, “but we understand and we know what to do until he comes”: watch, be alert, be on guard and be sober.

faqs.question: What does the word sober mean in 1 Thessalonians 5?
faqs.answer: He says the word sober there is abstaining from alcohol, and that drinking lowers your moral standards.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Therefore let us not sleep, as others do, but let us watch and be sober.

faqs.question: Do we have to wait till the end of time to win?
faqs.answer: He says no: “we can win now also if we stand up for morality and truth.”

faqs.question: How does he respond to being called a preacher of hate?
faqs.answer: He says “bring them on,” because God delivered His people out of the fiery furnace, and we turn away and follow Jesus and the Bible.
